pdfjs-dist 6.3.289 (Apache-2.0), unmodified.
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/pdfjs-dist/-/pdfjs-dist-6.3.289.tgz
Tarball sha1 (matches the registry's dist.shasum): 9e46d89489782a479f58d674ae5ddde8481aaa17
Files kept: legacy/build/pdf.min.mjs, legacy/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs, LICENSE -- the LEGACY build,
kept under the plain names build/ used, so nothing that loads them changed.
Why legacy (2026-09-09): the modern build's own top-level code references the Iterator global
unguarded, so it fails to import at all on any Safari before 18.4 (March 2025). The legacy build
is the same source at the same version, transpiled and bundled with core-js, which installs
Iterator and most of the other 2025-era built-ins pdf.js calls before that line runs. It does not
cover Promise.withResolvers; web/plate/pdfcompat.js does. See ARCHITECTURE.md, Phase 19 follow-ups.
Served from this machine only; the library fetches nothing when given bytes instead of a URL.
